title: Polish Potato Dumplings
description: A traditional Polish dish made with potato dumplings, perfect for a hearty lunch. Serve with a side of velvety sauce for extra flavor.
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash.
In a separate bowl, mix together the mashed potatoes, flour, and caraway seeds.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape into dumplings.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the dumplings for 5-7 minutes.
Drain the dumplings and serve with velvety sauce and polish sausage (if using).
Saute the onion in a pan until softened, then add to the sauce.
Simmer the sauce for 5-7 minutes until heated through.
